question_text: Describe, without code, how a program could store six timed pressure readings in two parallel lists so that each reading’s time can be recovered.
adaptation_rationale: Original application rewritten to be self-contained; assessed reasoning retained within cited 2027 scope.
solution: Create a list of times and a list of pressure values.; Use the same index to represent one observation in both lists.; Repeat input for all six observations.; Store each entered time and pressure at the matching positions.; When retrieving a pressure value, use its index to retrieve the associated time.
